out.page: Data Backup Back up your Desk data as a ZIP of CSV files. Backups can be downloaded for 7 days. A backup contains ALL of this organization's Desk data, regardless of your own record visibility or field permissions. Share and store the file with care, and protect it with a T_. Attachment files are included only if you choose to include them. New backup Choose what to back up. The backup runs in the background; you can leave this page. One full backup is allowed every 30 days. The next full backup can run on 23/11/2026; a custom backup can run any time. Full backup A full backup was taken in the last 30 days. The next one is allowed on 23/11/2026. Custom backup Only records changed within a date range of up to 31 days. From To Includes records last modified from the start of the first day to the end of the last day, up to 31 days. The ZIP holds one CSV per Desk module (tickets, contacts, accounts, products, activities, contracts, time entries and custom modules), conversations, the knowledge base, departments, teams, holidays, happiness ratings and the agent list. Include attachment files Adds the files attached to tickets and knowledge base articles. Files that are missing, deleted, quarantined or over 100 MB are left out and listed in the backup. Protect with a T_ Encrypts the ZIP with AES-256. The T_ is needed to open it and cannot be recovered. Back Up Now Scheduled backups Back up your Desk data automatically. The first scheduled backup is a full backup; each one after it holds only what changed since the previous successful scheduled backup.
